Method of Attack: Uses Google services (Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Forms) to host command-and-control infrastructure
Targets victims via spam email with boobytrapped Word documents containing embedded OLE objects disguised as images
Malware generates unique ID per infected computer and communicates with Google Apps Script to receive commands and upload stolen data
Previously contacted web or FTP servers for commands and data exfiltration
Impacted Systems: Windows PCs infected via malicious Word documents
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious Word documents containing embedded OLE objects
Indicators of Compromise: Boobytrapped Word documents with embedded OLE objects
